  {"step": 2, "file": "src/flb_pack.c", "function": "flb_msgpack_raw_to_json_sds", "line": 619, "var": "out_size", "code": "out_size = in_size * 1.5; out_buf = flb_sds_create_size(out_size);", "note": "Output sds buffer is allocated with capacity 768 (512*1.5); this fixed capacity bounds all subsequent writes."},

  {"step": 4, "file": "src/flb_pack.c", "function": "flb_msgpack_to_json", "line": 604, "var": "off", "code": "ret = msgpack2json(json_str, &off, json_size - 1, obj);", "note": "msgpack2json walks the object tree writing JSON; off tracks the current write offset within the 767-byte usable region."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/flb_pack.c", "function": "msgpack2json", "line": 489, "var": "o->via.str", "code": "try_to_write_str(buf, off, left, o->via.str.ptr, o->via.str.size)", "note": "For the MSGPACK_OBJECT_STR case, the 5-byte string 0xF4 0x81 0x81 0x81 0x81 is passed to flb_utils_write_str (try_to_write_str macro) for JSON escaping."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/flb_utils.c", "function": "flb_utils_write_str", "line": 683, "var": "c", "code": "else if (c > 0xFFFF) {", "note": "Byte 0xF4 read as a signed char becomes a large uint32_t (>0xFFFF), so the multi-byte UTF-8 branch is taken; flb_utf8_len reports hex_bytes=4."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/flb_utils.c", "function": "flb_utils_write_str", "line": 685, "var": "available - written", "code": "if (available - written < 6) { return FLB_FALSE; }", "note": "Only 6 bytes remain in the output buffer, which passes this check, but the actual encoded output can exceed 6 bytes for codepoints above 0xFFFF."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/flb_utils.c", "function": "flb_utils_write_str", "line": 708, "var": "len", "code": "len = snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp) - 1, \"\\\\u%04x\", codepoint);", "note": "The 4-byte sequence 0xF4 0x81 0x81 0x81 decodes to codepoint 0x41041 (>0xFFFF), so snprintf produces the 7-character string '\\u41041' (len=7), exceeding the 6 bytes that were checked."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/flb_utils.c", "function": "flb_utils_write_str", "line": 709, "var": "p", "code": "encoded_to_buf(p, tmp, len);", "note": "encoded_to_buf copies len=7 bytes into a region where only 6 bytes were verified available, writing 1 byte past the end of the heap output buffer: heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 1."}
]
EOF

6. `flb_utils.c:586` - `flb_utils_write_str` processes the string.

10. `flb_utils.c:709` - `encoded_to_buf(p, tmp, len)` writes 7 bytes but only 6 available → heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 1.
